case.believed: The pandas 3.0.4 CPython 3.14 Timedelta crash was only an isolated constructor spelling, so other equivalent constructor forms need no separate runtime proof.
contract: Constructing Timedelta with days=28, the string '28 days', and value 28 with unit='D' all survive on CPython 3.14 and produce the same duration.
Each positive result contains exactly 2419200000000000 nanoseconds and converts to datetime.timedelta(days=28).
A negative 28-day Timedelta preserves the signed nanosecond value and negates back to the positive duration.
case.goal: Prove pandas 3.0.5 wheels preserve Timedelta construction on CPython 3.14 after the pandas 3.0.4 segmentation-fault regression
